name: Voice Agent — IN4 Inbound Post-Call Processing

parameters.content:
## WF-IN4 — Inbound Post-Call Processing

Triggered ASYNC by WF-IN2 after every inbound call ends.
No time constraint — fire and forget.

**Flow:**
1. Parse VAPI end-of-call-report payload
2. Halt if no phone number
3. Short call (< 10s):
   - Known caller → update Last Contact + Call Count only
   - Unknown caller → Activity Log only (no Clients row)
4. Full call:
   - Read Clients + Appointment Log + Messages
   - Build update payload (outcome, name, email, service, SMS text)
   - Update Clients tab (appendOrUpdate by Phone — creates row if new caller)
   - Write Activity Log (always)
   - If urgent message → SMS alert to business owner
   - Route by outcome → SMS to caller (booked / callback-requested / callback-scheduled)

**Upstream:** WF-IN2 (async fire on end-of-call-report)
**Downstream:** None — end of chain
**Sheets:** Reads Clients + Appt Log + Messages. Writes Clients + Activity Log.

⚠️ Before activating: replace PLACEHOLDER_TWILIO_NUMBER and PLACEHOLDER_OWNER_PHONE in Client Config.

**Short Call Path (< 10s)**

Caller hung up before AI engaged.

- Known caller → update Last Contact + Call Count only. No Status change.
- Unknown caller → Activity Log row only. No Clients row created.

Outcome: `inbound-incomplete`
No SMS sent for short calls.

**Full Call Path (≥ 10s)**

Real conversation — full CRM processing.

Reads Clients + Appt Log + Messages in sequence.
Build Update Payload merges all data.
Fan-out: Update Clients + Write Activity Log in parallel.
Post-write: Urgent alert + Outcome SMS.

**Follow-Up Actions**

Three parallel branches from Update Client Record:

**Branch 1 — Urgent Alert:**
If caller left urgent message → SMS internal alert to business owner.

**Branch 2 — Outcome SMS:**
- booked → booking confirmation
- callback-requested → 'we'll be in touch'
- callback-scheduled → 'callback confirmed for [time]'
- All others → no SMS

⚠️ Set twilioFromNumber + businessOwnerPhone in Client Config.

parameters.errorMessage: WF-IN4 halted: No phone number extracted from VAPI end-of-call-report. Cannot process inbound call without a phone number.

parameters.message: ={{ '⚠️ Inbound call from ' + $('Build Update Payload').first().json.phone + ' ended with an UNRECOGNISED outcome: \'' + $('Build Update Payload').first().json.outcome + '\'. No follow-up SMS was sent. Review the call and follow up manually.' }}

={{ '⚠️ CRM OUT OF SYNC: inbound post-call update for ' + $('Build Update Payload').first().json.phone + ' (outcome: ' + $('Build Update Payload').first().json.outcome + ') failed to write to the Clients tab. The customer SMS was still sent. Update the CRM row manually — follow-up automation will use stale data until you do.' }}
